info.title: Cconnect Customer API
info.description: Company-scoped REST API for Cconnect Desk and Chat. Bearer credentials are issued by your company administrator. Public documentation does not grant data access. Operations require CustomerApi:Enabled on the API deployment.

post.description: Queues WhatsApp text or an approved template, or an email reply with ticket_id. Requires whatsapp:send + Chat or email:send + Desk. Email uses the ticket's configured Gmail/SMTP sender and requester; omit to. SMS and attachments are not supported. Idempotent retries return the original acceptance with the same message ID. Check `GET /api/v1/messages/{id}` for current status.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per operation and company, 1–128 visible ASCII characters. Identical retries return the original 202 acceptance and message ID. Changed requests return 409. Retained for the company lifetime. Check the message resource for current status.
